node.statement: Apply lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation with D:=D_*, t:=t_3, B_R:=B_U oplus B_V, and the raw call u_R:=u_3 from node 1.1. Its hypotheses hold: D_*>=1 and all W constant bounds come from lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger; 0<=t_3<=W.r_reset, A_R is extended epsilon_R-C*, and epsilon_R<=t_3 come from node 1.1; and u_3 is an extended D_*t_3-isomorphism, hence an extended D_*t_3-inclusion, with the required D_*t_3 near-unit bound. The lemma therefore gives an error-improved map v_R:B_U oplus B_V->A_R with d_R<=W.c0_cb*epsilon_R and ||v_R(I_{B_U oplus B_V})-u_{A_R}||<=W.c0_cb*epsilon_R; because u_3 is bijective, its preservation clause makes v_R bijective, and it leaves source, target corner, and amplification form unchanged.
